purpose: Recover true positive turnover ratios only where BaoStock active-trade turn is quantized to 0.000000 percent and a PIT-public exact floating-share denominator is independently bound.
zero_reconstruction_rule: Require tradestatus=1, positive finite volume and amount, source turn exactly zero, a symbol/date-matched PIT denominator binding, and volume/floating_shares*100 strictly below half one source precision unit. Positive-turn neighbors in the bound window must reproduce the provider value within half one precision unit.

entries.source_document: 湖南千山制药机械股份有限公司2019年年度报告

provider_crosscheck.method: BaoStock positive-turn rows: implied shares = volume / (turn_percent/100)
